items.summary: Approve the CEO recommendation. Continue existing source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work only. Do not create or queue new production work, requeue failures, add telemetry or dependencies, change configuration, spend, expand monetization, conduct external outreach, or adopt external components. Preserve failed-work isolation until canonical lineage, ownership, root cause, focused validation, rollback, deduplication, and explicit disposition are documented. Keep the gated product private pending rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates. Preserve unknown financial, causal, and operational outcomes.

Retain control-plane lineage, lifecycle and measurement visibility, queue-capacity reporting, accessible CTA patterns, and repository prototypes as deferred concepts only. They are technically feasible in principle but lack queue capacity and require isolated implementation, deterministic validation, rollback evidence, and applicable owner, security, and measurement gates before queue entry.

Keep the gated product private and continue the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix. External outreach, public exposure, alert expansion, deployment, configuration or credential changes, dependency additions, monetization, and spend remain blocked pending human-counsel review, owner authorization, and completion of legal, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates. Use existing telemetry only; do not invent or request duplicate telemetry.
